letter.company_line: Carelli Constructions provides design, construction and project management services for commercial and industrial projects from Notting Hill.
letter.subject: Graduate/Undergraduate, Project Management
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Graduate/Undergraduate Project Management role. Supporting your project managers with drawing registers, revision control, RFIs, procurement and site inspections is the coordination and documentation work I want to build my career in.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, where I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). That study gave me a practical understanding of design coordination, constructability and how works move from concept to documentation.

I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton VIC. My site experience is from the Philippines and my coursework was civil rather than commercial building, so I would learn your systems and contracts quickly and keep accurate records from day one.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

screening_answers.a: Not visible before signing in; answer from the resume and cover letter. Work rights: Subclass 485, full working rights to December 2027. Licence: Australian driver's licence and own transport. Salary and start date: Marc to answer.
